The new campaign, running November 2 through December 7, will feature a variety of goodies, with the all-new Japanese destroyer Shigure at the top of the pile. She's a hybrid option for playing Japanese destroyers. Her solid artillery suite and great concealment, paired with state-of-the-art, high-speed, hard-hitting torpedoes, put her in firmly in the running for the best in her tier. Plus, Shigure is the only Japanese destroyer to boast access to the combo of Exhaust Smoke Generator and Sonar. With the Engine Boost consumable further enhancing her speed, you're in for a rare treat.

notes.title: Ranked, Brawl, and Fleet Cup: Magnificent Trio

items.text: There's plenty of ways to play your favorite game in this update! First of all, Fleet Cup returns for the 8th season, with 5v5 battles allowing only Tech Tree ships with no carriers included, available on each Friday, Saturday and Sunday of the update. The Ranked seasons are coming in hot, too: three straight week-long seasons of 1v1 Tier VII action, with the first one starting as early as November 3. Here's the full schedule:
Season 110: November 3–9, battleships only
Season 111: November 10–16, cruisers only
Season 112: November 17–23, destroyers only

Last but definitely not least comes the Asymmetric Brawl, challenging you to take on 12 AI-controlled enemies in a team of five between November 24 and 30. Keep your eyes peeled for the dedicated articles; each will dive into the details of the different battle types.
[img src="https://navy-media-lepo-prod.wgcdn.co/lepo/media/news_gallery/15f7b20dd6904ce8bc1a2cafb24be7dd.jpg" style="max-width: 100%;"]

A special event will be held to commemorate the anniversary of the Battle of Taranto. Within a free mission, active between November 9 and 30, you'll be able to score a variety of themed goods, including a unique flag. On top of that, expect discounts for British and Italian ships, all of that coupled with an option to acquire Napoli B for doubloons and Warspite B for Global XP through chained bundles.
[img src="https://navy-media-lepo-prod.wgcdn.co/lepo/media/news_gallery/144802670b87483489123f9ebf8b7105.jpg" style="max-width: 100%;"]

Besides that, Soviet battleships are receiving a new Commander you can put at their helm. Zinovy Rozhestvensky is a prominent historical figure and comes with an array of new skills (including a new Legendary skill) focused on improving both the offensive and defensive capabilities of your ship. His Mad Dog base trait improves your battleship's main battery damage within 11 km range by up to 6%, while his "The Long Voyage" unique skill increases Repair Party duration (by up to 30%) and reduces its cooldown time (by up to 20%), while also increasing the total citadel HP restored by that consumable by up to 20% in a new unique effect. However, HP healed per second decreases (by up to 10%) to balance out all the bonuses.
Here's a list of the new skills
Shrapnel-Proof reduces the fire-catching chance for your ship and fire damage to your battleship by up to 10% and 5% respectively.
Concentrated Fire improves battleship main battery shell grouping by up to 7.5%, and subsequent AP shell damage to the same target with each AP shell hit by up to 5% total.
All or Nothing reduces minimum and guaranteed ricochet angles for shells that hit your battleship by up to 5% each; increases damage to your ship's extremities by up to 5%.

Test of Endurance reduces Damage Control Party cooldown time by up to 10% and increases its duration by up to 10%; grants one extra charge to all consumables; and reduces incoming damage from shells, torpedoes, and bombs to your battleship while Damage Control Party is active by up to 10%.

Unbreakable (Legendary skill) reduces torpedo damage to your ship (by up to 20%). It also grants a special effect that reduces incoming damage to your battleship by up to 10% and makes your modules immune to damage and disabling. This special effect activates when an enemy ship is within a range of 6 km (at maximum skill mastery).
You'll be able to acquire this Commander via a dedicated prolonged mission running throughout the update.

items.text: The Road to New Year event does not stop here! Continue accumulating Giftlets through various activities so that you can acquire a selection of rewards when the next update starts, with a choice between Ohio, Lenin, and Jean Bart as the biggest holiday treat. A detailed look, including a dedicated video, is available here.

From October 12 to November 2, complete the "Marine Nationale: 400 Years" mission to earn a themed flag and background, 10x Promotion Orders, and 1x French Battleship crate. From October 12 to November 2, commemorate the Battle of Trafalgar—the decisive naval clash of the Napoleonic Wars fought on October 21, 1805, where the British fleet, commanded by Vice Admiral Horatio Nelson, defeated the combined Franco-Spanish fleet. Visit the Store to claim the "Trafalgar: Breaking the Line" free mission exclusively for British, French, and Spanish ships. Completing this mission will bring you British and French national camouflages, the Trafalgar Day flag, and 1x Royal Benevolence crate. This new crate can drop a British Premium ship, including two new ones—Tier V battleship Royal Sovereign and Tier VII aircraft carrier Theseus—plus Tier VI cruiser Belfast and Tier VII battleship Rodney. You'll also find various themed content in the Store, including discounted French battleships and a chained bundle with French Tier VII Premium battleship Picardie in the final bundle.

From October 19 to November 2, we'll be commemorating the biggest naval clash of World War II that took place on October 23–26, 1944. First of all, you can join three new missions, each reflecting a major phase of the battle: the San Bernardino Strait transit, Ozawa's decoy operation to lure Task Force 38 away, and the Battle of Surigao Strait. Completing each mission with specific historical ships will be much faster—see the details for each mission once the event is live. The rewards include Commander crates and new player backgrounds.

Additionally, check out the Store during the event for discounts on ships that participated in the battle. You'll also find a special bundle where you can choose one of the two new history-inspired permanent camouflages—one for Massachusetts and another for Atago—and obtain it for Global XP. The remaining one will be available for doubloons.

New Pan-American Legendary Tier destroyer La Pampa is coming to the Store for Steel on October 5 and will remain there indefinitely. This ship allows for a hybrid playstyle, combining strong firepower with potent torpedo armament. She's equipped with two 113 mm twin main battery turrets mounted on the bow, as well as 15 torpedo tubes arranged across three launchers at the stern. Both her main battery and torpedoes benefit from fast reload times, allowing her to effectively engage enemy destroyers with gunfire while maintaining consistent pressure on larger ships with torpedo attacks. La Pampa also boasts a versatile set of consumables, including a Smoke Generator, Torpedo Reload Booster, and the choice between an enhanced Repair Party and Advanced Sonar.
Need more Steel? Here's how to earn it in the upcoming update:

The Steel Harvest weekly mission for the new Halloween battle type, unlocked once you complete the Shard Harvest mission (which resets after two weeks of the event, so you need to complete it again to unlock Steel Harvest for weeks 3 and 4): Up to 3,200 Steel in total

She's equipped with nine 457 mm guns, delivering some of the highest AP damage per second among battleships at her tier. Her good concealment lets her move closer to the fight before being spotted, while her high speed gives her the flexibility to reposition quickly, exploit weak flanks, and create crossfires.

notes.title: Modern Era Goes On: New Operations, Balance Tweaks, and Results

items.text: More PvE and PvP Action

As we promised, the Modern Era mode will stay for another update, up until October 5. In the new update, we're adding small improvements to existing PvE operations and introducing two new ones, so expect fresh twists and challenges!

Undefined Threat challenges you to protect an offshore oil rig from destruction. If the enemy destroys the oil rig, your mission fails! Luckily, emergency repair stations will appear across the battlefield—it takes only a single ship to secure one and restore some HP to your entire fleet and the oil rig.

Taxation by Flame urges you to destroy the enemy's network of oil rigs. Once taken down, a rig explodes, destroying everyone within range and creating a burning oil field that damages everything inside of it!

We've also prepared three additional PvP scenarios, built around Standard and Epicenter objectives, and the new weekly mission "Crude and Steel". Complete it in Modern Era PvP mode to receive 750 Steel each week!
Balance Changes to Modern Era Ships
We reviewed the first weeks of the Modern Era mode, including how ships performed, so we're introducing a few tweaks to several ships to make battles more balanced.
List of changes

Missile defense system damage reduced from 475 to 450 per second

We've also slightly tweaked battle earnings in Modern Era Mode:
In PvP battles, credit and XP earnings will be increased by 15%.
In PvE hard mode, credit earnings will be reduced by 20% and XP earnings will be reduced by 5.5%.
Faction War Results

We'll check the final score and determine the winner of the faction war on October 4. A new ship is arriving in the Store on September 14, available for Global XP: British Tier VII Premium aircraft carrier Indomitable! During the war, this ship served valiantly in the Mediterranean, providing air cover during Operations Pedestal and Husky. Later in the Pacific theater, Indomitable served as flagship for the British Pacific Fleet. She suffered a kamikaze attack in May 1945, but received minimal damage thanks to her armored flight deck.

Indomitable is armed with HE skip bombers, notable for carrying a single, powerful skip bomb per plane, requiring precision and timing to land devastating blows. items.text: The moment we've been waiting for is here! Everything you love about World of Warships: Legends—the fast-paced naval combat, the legendary warships, the epic battles—is now on PC at full sail and ready to play!
🔄 Cross-progression: Take it all with you
If you've been playing Legends on console or mobile, your progress can transfer to PC.
When launching the game on Steam for the first time, simply log in using your existing account.
You can sign in with a Microsoft (Xbox), PlayStation, Apple, Google, or Facebook account.
Your progress will sync automatically across platforms.

⚠️ Important: You can only sync your account the first time you log in on PC. If you create a fresh account for Legends on Steam, you will not be able to link it to your existing progress. Choose carefully, Captains!
If you prefer to start from scratch, just create a new account via Steam when you first log in and you'll be good to set sail.
🎁 A massive thank you to our Beta Testers

To everyone who jumped into the PC Beta—thank you. Your feedback, your bug reports, your battles, and your patience helped shape the version of Legends that launches today. We couldn't have done this without you, and we owe you some rewards.

As a special thank you, we've prepared exclusive flags based on what tests you took part in. The rewards should typically arrive within 24 hours after logging in with the Steam account you used in the playtests, though it's possible that they may take couple of days to appear.
Hang tight, you'll get them!

The launch party isn't just rocking the high seas—it's happening on Discord too. To celebrate the PC release, we're running a launch competition with cool prizes, kicking off Wednesday, May 6. Don't miss it!
Anchors aweigh, Captains. We'll see you on the waves.

Our upcoming September Playtest sets sail with a range of improvements and changes across the Steam version. This Playtest is part of the September Update, bringing content that's nearly on par with what's available on console and mobile.
Max account level increased to 9.
Auto‑login enabled: Launch the game and you’ll be signed in automatically.
Available battle types: Versus AI, Arcade, Standard, Brawl, Ranked
Note: Some modes listed above may not be available during this Playtest.
Quick commands: Now available in battle.
Commander presets: Save and recall preferred Commander configurations.
Steam Deck (experimental support): The game can now be launched on Steam Deck. UI improvements are planned for future updates.
o Rich presence – see what modes your friends are playing.
o Recent players – track recent teammates and opponents.
o Steam timelines – shows sunk ship markers in recorded gameplay.
Key binding customization: Full ability to remap keyboard controls.
Gamepad support: Early-stage support available for Port and in-battle modes.
More improvements will come in the future.
Advanced graphics options: Including HDR, ray tracing, and display monitor selection.
Scroll system overhaul: Smoother and more responsive UI scrolling.
Nickname change: Editable from the Settings menu.
Service record screen: Fully implemented and accessible.
UI enhancements: Improved clarity and responsiveness for Close/Back buttons.
Voice chat: Fully enabled for supported game modes (Division and all battle types).
Notifications: In-game alerts and messages are fully functional.
Bundles: Random and chained bundles are now functional.
Improved Close/Back button visibility and behavior.
Social links added to menu/Port.
Loadout and Commander usability improvements.
